summary: Enhance your workplace dynamics with our Building Effective Employee Relations Programs training course. Learn strategies to foster collaboration and engagement
lede: Employee relations training helps HR professionals structure consistent responses to workplace concerns. It covers case triage, investigation planning and evidence records, grievance handling, conflict resolution, and manager support. Participants also practise analysing case trends and employee voice, reporting findings, and planning improvements to employee relations processes.
audienceIntro: This course is designed for professionals who manage employee relations cases, advise leaders, investigate workplace concerns, or build people processes across teams. It suits intermediate practitioners who already handle workplace issues and need a more structured program model, stronger documentation, and clearer reporting.
modules: Employee Relations Foundations and Program Design
Case Intake, Triage, and Risk Assessment
prerequisites: You should have practical exposure to HR operations, people management, employee relations, workplace investigations, or employee experience work. Familiarity with your organization’s HR policies and case-handling process will help you apply the exercises. No coding or programming is required. You should bring a laptop if your delivery format supports digital dashboard and workflow exercises. Employment-law interpretation remains outside scope because legal requirements vary by jurisdiction; the course focuses on transferrable process design, evidence handling, communication, and governance practices.
